item.title: A Day of Community, Footy and Family Fun - Wenty Leagues
item.description: Ringrose Oval hosted our Magpie Family Fun Day on Sunday 13 July as families from across the community came together for family fun.

item.title: 2025 Cumberland ClubGRANTS Presentation - Wenty Leagues
item.description: We were proud to host the 2025 Cumberland ClubGRANTS Presentation, an event that honours the invaluable contributions to community charities.

item.title: The Big Spin: Pedalling with Purpose to Support Families in Need - Wenty Leagues
item.description: We proudly joined Ronald McDonald House Charities GWS for The Big Spin, a high-energy, 12-hour spin cycling challenge for charity.

item.title: We took part in the Cancer Council 7 Bridges Walk - Wenty Leagues
item.description: On Sunday 26 October, the Wenty Team took part in the Cancer Council’s 7 Bridges Walk to raise vital funds for cancer research.

item.title: Wenty to Host the Nines Premier League - Wenty Leagues
item.description: The Nines Premier League Sydney Qualifier, proudly presented by Wenty Leagues, takes place on November 29 and 30 at Ringrose Oval. Grab your tickets and join us in celebrating another proud moment in Wenty Leagues history.

item.title: Touchdown in the USA Promotion - Wenty Leagues
item.description: ONE LUCKY MEMBER IS HEADING TO THE SUPER BOWL! The team at Wenty want to thank all who participated in the Touchdown in the USA promotion.

item.description: The spirit of community was on full display as thousands of locals gathered at Ringrose Oval for the much-loved annual event, Carols on Ringrose.

item.description: We are proud to mark the official completion of our Entertainment Hub transformation, an exciting milestone that brings together years of planning and vision.

item.description: In line with updated regulatory requirements relating to gaming operations in NSW, the Club will be adjusting its daily trading hours.

item.title: ClubGRANTS 2026 Applications Are Now Open - Wenty Leagues
item.description: Do you know a local organisation in need of support for their community project? Applications for 2026 are now open and close on Friday 26th May 2026 at 5pm.
